checksum/crc#

Immutable CRC values over byte chunks.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let first = Crc32([byte(49), byte(50), byte(51), byte(52)]);
let whole = first.state([byte(53), byte(54), byte(55), byte(56), byte(57)]);
whole.checksum(); // 3421780262 ("123456789")

Description#

Immutable CRC values over byte chunks. Both objects compute lazily in checksum() without mutation or memoization. state(bytes) computes the receiver's value, then returns a successor retaining only the new chunk and resulting seed. Input arrays and earlier states remain unchanged; branches and repeats are valid. Empty chunks preserve the initial value. No I/O or owned resources. The runtime computes them (#193); results are non-negative integers. These checksums are not cryptographic digests. Encode text explicitly.

Crc32 is CRC-32/ISO-HDLC: width 32, polynomial 0x04C11DB7, reflected input and output, init register 0xFFFFFFFF, xorout 0xFFFFFFFF. The public seed is a finalized CRC (as in zlib), so it is XORed before and after calculation. Crc32()/Crc32(bytes) default to public seed 0. Crc32(origin: bytes, initial: initial) requires 0..4294967295 and throws InvalidChecksumInitial at construction otherwise.

Public API#

object Crc32#

object Crc32 does Checksumming

CRC-32 as gzip, zip and PNG use it.

Crc32.Crc32#

Crc32()

The checksum of nothing yet; state(bytes) feeds it.

Crc32.Crc32#

Crc32(origin is @byte)

The checksum of these bytes.

Crc32.Crc32#

Crc32(origin is @byte, initial is int)

The checksum of these bytes continued from initial.

Crc32.checksum#

checksum() is int

Computed by the runtime (#193), the same CRC as eight bit steps a byte.

Crc32.state#

state(origin is @byte) is ^Crc32

The checksum of everything fed so far and then origin.

object Crc16Ccitt#

object Crc16Ccitt does Checksumming

CRC-16 with polynomial 0x1021, MSB first, no input/output reflection and no final XOR. The mandatory seed directly initializes the 16-bit register; there is deliberately no implicit choice of a CCITT variant. Crc16Ccitt(initial) denotes the empty chunk; Crc16Ccitt(origin: bytes, initial: initial) binds bytes. Both require 0..65535 or throw InvalidChecksumInitial immediately. "123456789" gives 10673 with seed 65535, or 12739 with seed 0. These exact parameters match binascii.crc_hqx, not the reflected KERMIT/X-25 variants.

Crc16Ccitt.Crc16Ccitt#

Crc16Ccitt(initial is int)

CRC-16/CCITT of nothing yet, starting from initial (0xFFFF for CCITT-FALSE, 0 for XMODEM).

Crc16Ccitt.Crc16Ccitt#

Crc16Ccitt(origin is @byte, initial is int)

CRC-16/CCITT of these bytes, starting from initial.

Crc16Ccitt.checksum#

checksum() is int

Computed by the runtime (#193).

Crc16Ccitt.state#

state(origin is @byte) is ^Crc16Ccitt

The checksum of everything fed so far and then origin.
